limitations: One fresh engine per profile and one public recording; not an accent/negative corpus or latency nonregression.
Only the measured child engine is included. The external Python meter, service, capture, replay and settings are excluded.
Approximately 100 ms sampling can miss brief peaks. Waiting is a short three-second observation after ready; no soak or plateau claim.
The Vosk-only arm explicitly disables accurate recognition and is not a proposed production default.
Both private working set and private commit are reported; high private commit is not itself evidence of a leak.
